name: AgentFlow-DocDancer-benchmark
description: A document-centered benchmark focusing on agent workflows and document understanding tasks. It measures model ability to read, interpret, and act on document content (question answering and instruction following over documents) and to support agent-style interactions with documents. Evaluation emphasizes correctness of extracted answers and fidelity to document content.
evaluation_method: exact_match / F1 (answer overlap) and task-specific correctness scoring
general_score_metric: exact_match (primary) with F1 used for partial credit
reputation: A niche Hugging Face-hosted benchmark with limited but growing use among document-AI and agent-evaluation communities.
